svg.aria-label: Career ladder. Step 1: Webyalaya, Full Stack Intern, Nov 2025 – Feb 2026 (done): API latency 1,200 → 700 ms; Prometheus · Grafana · Sentry; Idempotent Razorpay gateway; Transcription calls cut 60%. Step 2: Edumorph, SDE Intern, Aug 2026 – Present (current): Redis Cluster + BullMQ pipeline; 250+ Razorpay transactions; FCM push to 2,000+ users; Signup conversion 55% → 78%. Step 3: eBay, Summer Intern, Summer 2027 (next): Next rung on the ladder; Software engineering internship.
